title: Veterinary Authorization Standard for Tailwise Pharmacy Prescriptions
content:
*Pharmacist-in-charge practice standard.*

## A. Authority to dispense

A.1 Every new Tailwise Pharmacy prescription and every renewal is dispensed only on the prescribing veterinarian's authorization. The pharmacy never fills on the customer's word or on a photo of a label.

## B. Conditions checked when the order is placed

B.1 **Prescriber.** When the class requires a DEA-registered prescriber, the prescribing veterinarian's record shows the veterinarian as DEA registered.

B.2 **Destination.** The customer's shipping state is not listed among the class's restricted shipping states.

B.3 **Weight.** When the class requires the weight-band check, the pet's weight is checked only if it was recorded no earlier than the class's weight-record age limit before the order date.

B.4 **Counting the weight age.** The weight age is counted in calendar months back from the order date, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist; a weight recorded exactly on that boundary date is current. The dates compared are the order date and the date the pet's current weight was recorded, as the pet profile shows it.

B.5 **Failing a condition.** An order failing one of B.1 to B.3 is not sent to the veterinarian and is cancelled the same day with the reason explained.

All three conditions are read from the system records — the veterinarian's record, the customer profile's shipping state and the pet profile's weight date — for the veterinarian, the customer and the pet of that order.

### Weight-age boundary (hypothetical dates)

| Class limit | Order date | Boundary date | Weight recorded on | Current? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 calendar months | 2026-08-31 | 2026-02-28 (no 31st in February) | 2026-02-28 | Yes |
| 6 calendar months | 2026-08-31 | 2026-02-28 | 2026-02-27 | No |
| 12 calendar months | 2026-03-15 | 2025-03-15 | 2025-03-15 | Yes |
| 12 calendar months | 2026-03-15 | 2025-03-15 | 2025-03-14 | No |

## C. Requesting and following up

C.1 The pharmacy sends the first authorization request within the class's first-request period of the order, through one of the class's authorization channels.

C.2 After each attempt the pharmacy waits the class's response period in business days (Monday to Friday, excluding federal holidays), and follows up until the class's number of attempts has been made.

C.3 When the last attempt goes unanswered the request closes as no response and the prescription is denied with the denial reason no response.

## D. Recording the answer

D.1 The prescription status is pending veterinarian authorization when an approval or denial is recorded.

D.2 On approval the fills authorized are the first fill plus the refills the veterinarian wrote, never more than the class's largest number of refills on one authorization.

D.3 The expiry date is the earlier of the veterinarian's written expiry and the authorization date plus the class's validity in calendar months (month-end falls back to the last day of the month).

D.4 A denial records the veterinarian's reason and closes the prescription. Where the class requires a new veterinarian contact for resubmission, the customer may only place a new order after speaking to the veterinarian.

### Expiry illustration (hypothetical)

Authorization recorded on 2026-08-31 for a class valid 6 calendar months: the validity date falls on 2027-02-28, February having no 31st. If the veterinarian wrote an expiry of 2027-01-15, the expiry date is 2027-01-15, the earlier of the two; if the written expiry falls after 2027-02-28, or the veterinarian wrote no expiry, it is 2027-02-28.
